fixes: **Two report addresses could produce an error page.** Asking for an impossibly long time range ("the last 99999999 months") or a report address carrying a mistyped person reference returned a server error instead of a report. Both are now handled: an absurd range is treated as "everything", and a reference that cannot exist is ignored rather than crashing. Reports are shareable links, so a hand-edited or truncated one should never break the page. ---
